features: Noise-profile reduction for steady hum, hiss and fan noise in recordings
use_cases: Reduce background noise in recorded audio.

conditions: Select a noise-only passage to capture a profile, then preview reduction on the recording.
limitations: Irregular traffic, isolated clicks and heavily overlapping sound need other repair methods; aggressive reduction can distort wanted audio.
This evidence covers recorded-file processing, not a live microphone filter.

sources.label: Official Noise Reduction manual: profile, suitable noise and limitations

use_cases: Multitrack audio/MIDI, routing, scripting, portable operation and plugin support
Reduce background noise in recorded audio.

conditions: Use the included ReaFIR effect in Subtract mode and learn a profile from a noise-only section.
limitations: Profile subtraction requires careful listening and adjustment; this review does not establish live microphone routing or comparative restoration quality.
